diet103/claude-code-infrastructure-showc.procedure: "This is NOT a working application - it's a reference library. Copy what you need into your own projects." Option A: `git clone https://github.com/diet103/claude-code-infrastructure-showcase.git` then `npx tsx setup.ts ~/my-project`. Option B, manual: "1. Clone this repo 2. Copy .claude/ into YOUR project 3. Install hook dependencies". README: "Time investment to build: 6 months of iteration. Time to integrate into your project: 15-30 minutes."
diet103/claude-code-infrastructure-showc.judgement_note: The reader's action is a one-time scaffold per project. After it, nothing manual recurs: the hooks the document installs are what run, automatically, on every prompt and every edit. A one-time copy is not a repeated procedure, and reading it as one is exactly the reading that would manufacture an unmet need.
diet103/claude-code-infrastructure-showc.what_it_shows_instead: The need is being served by copying a directory of files into a repository, not by installing a package.
